rows.label: bf01080100_0010
rows.name: What, that's it?!

rows.label: bf01080100_0020
rows.name:
Don't be unreasonable. I'm already
giving you extra, mo.

rows.label: bf01080100_0030
rows.name:
If it were military supplies,
I'd pay you extra, mo.

rows.label: bf01080100_0040
rows.name:
Superbia and Invidia had a ceasefire,
but now they're both preparing for war.

rows.label: bf01080100_0050
rows.name:
No matter how much there is,
it's not enough, mo.

rows.label: bf01080100_0060
rows.name:
How about it, mo? Interested
in that kind of work, mo?

rows.label: bf01080100_0070
rows.name:
I told you before, I stay
away from that sorta thing.

rows.label: bf01080100_0080
rows.name:
Ahh, with skills like yours,
you could make a fortune, mo~

rows.label: bf01080100_0090
rows.name: Such a waste, mo. Such a waste, mo~

rows.label: bf01080100_0100
rows.name: So? What'll you do, mo?

rows.label: bf01080100_0110
rows.name: I'll take your offer.

rows.label: bf01080100_0120
rows.name: 200 now, and the rest as usual.

rows.label: bf01080100_0130
rows.name: Got it, mo.

rows.label: bf01080100_0140
rows.name:
Send it to Correl-san in Iyasaki
Village, right, mo?

rows.label: bf01080100_0150
rows.name: Yeah.

rows.label: bf01080100_0160
rows.name:
Still, sending money home at your age
brings tears to my eyes, mo...

rows.label: bf01080100_0170
rows.name:
I wish my fool of a son would
learn from you, mo.

rows.label: bf01080100_0180
rows.name: It's because Gramps lets me live rent-free.

rows.label: bf01080100_0190
rows.name: All right, I'm counting on you!

rows.label: bf01080100_0200
rows.name: Yes, mo. Leave it to me, mo.
